args.body: Use walmart-route-pointers.json if committed to distinguish merchandise onboarding from a published route for service proposals. If the Walmart capture gives no credible service route, use the remaining merchant slot if available. Check the proposal route before spending effort comparing variants. For a supported route and a reproducible same-variant issue, run the failing and clean fictional controls and leave the private AI-disclosed CAD proposal. If either condition is missing, save the decisive source evidence and what would reopen the prospect. Read back and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

description: Walmart Canada’s captured supplier page describes merchandise purchasing. It has yet to establish a route for offering catalogue QA services. That limits the Walmart proposal. The existing pilot can still test one other merchant with a documented service proposal route. Treasury is UNFUNDED with CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available with no new classified signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The SQLite referral packet and patch hashes match, but the available contribution evidence does not bind an independent readiness verdict to both. The submission decision can advance when that verdict is available.
